name: Lugach
text: Lugach is a daughter of Fionn mac Cumhaill in ballads of the Fenian Cycle. She is the mother of Mac Lughach. The name also appears in the form Lughach, and a masculine variant of it serves as a name form for the figure Lugaid.
attributes: daughter of Fionn mac Cumhaill in Fenian Cycle ballads
mother of the Fenian warrior Mac Lughach

okr.objective: Documents Lugach, a minor Fenian Cycle figure defined by her kinship ties.
